Watts printed the hymn under Song of Songs 3:11. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Come out, O daughters of Zion, and gaze at King Solomon, wearing the crown his mother bestowed on the day of his wedding— the day of his heart’s rejoicing. SONG OF SONGS 3:11 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ SONG OF SONGS 3
